ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Front` and `Back`, two copies of `Tally`, each in its own `Counting` state.
Someone comes in at the front: the self-loop of `Front`'s copy fires and adds one to `frontCount`. `Back`'s copy does nothing.
`front` is still true (inputs keep their value), so `Front`'s copy counts again: 2.
Now the back door: only `Back`'s copy counts.
Both doors at once: both copies take their self-loop in the same tick, each adding one to its own output.
Nobody: 3 at the front, 2 at the back. Each copy has counted only its own door.
